scope: All authored Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, CSS and JSON in games/cs16 and scripts/cs16; full web/src/audio-spatial.ts, web/src/game-api/default-players.ts and their registered web/tests; added lines only in web/src/audio.ts and web/src/game-api/module.ts and web/src/game-api/host.tsx; this is not a whole-repository check; full scripts/test_cdn_manual_gzip.py and added lines only in scripts/cdn_delivery.py; full registered Unchanged Go tests and added lines only in internal/gameapi/module.go and internal/server/realtime_stream.go; full action-scope.ts and action-scope.test.mjs, added lines only in main.tsx; full internal/server/session_cache.go and session_cache_e2e_test.go, added lines only in internal/server/server.go; full declared Deferred Input Go tests, added lines only in internal/server/realtime_batch.go; added lines in legacy/room-ui.tsx for stable add-bot action; shared waiting CSS and chat/controller UI fixtures are covered in room-ui-lint
rules: All code comments and Python docstrings are prohibited
TypeScript/JavaScript and Go bindings use camelCase/PascalCase; uppercase snake constants are permitted in TypeScript/JavaScript
Python bindings use snake_case, uppercase snake constants, and PascalCase classes
Go package names match engine, server, data, command and test directory roles

CS16 deterministic Go prefixes and private input/prediction TypeScript retain integer-chain types and literals; generic shared Go/TS permit floating calculation but reject floating business comparisons
Dynamic evaluation, TypeScript any, cross-game implementation imports, direct audio players and embedded media payloads are prohibited
Original BSP, WAD, MDL, image, audio, video, model, archive and WebAssembly payloads cannot enter Git, including assets/public; only registered ignored external payloads are restored
Temporary output paths are restricted to .local/cs16 and system-default temporary directories are prohibited
CSS classes and custom properties use kebab-case; JSON must parse and cannot contain prototype keys
Symlink traversal and unsupported source locations are rejected

assets/public is externally restored payload: exclude it from authored source parsing only while every file is registered and verified against assets/resources.json bytes and SHA-256; authored assets metadata outside public remains checked

Shared platform spatial audio may own an AudioContext and native media but cannot route to AudioContext.destination; its destination must be a MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode feeding the platform native media channel
Shared spatial audio sources and tests receive complete checks; existing audio.ts and game-api/module.ts are inspected only at Git-added lines, preserving pre-existing comments and unrelated source

Registered shared Go files use explicitly mapped server/gameapi packages; full new files and added lines in existing files retain integer/no-comment/no-game-import rules without exempting any game rule
Go forbids unsafe imports and package-global sql.Register/sqlite.RegisterConnectionHook references, including aliases; instance SQLite connection hooks remain allowed
Generic comparison checks follow numeric variables, fields, local function returns, tolerance, extrema and sort APIs; explicit quantization and integer guards establish integer comparison operands
